blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.auditLog` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of audit logs, newest first. It sends a
request to the List Audit Logs API route. The route is only available when
the Audit Module is installed.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of audit logs to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of audit logs to skip.

children.name: order
children.description: The sort order. Audit logs can only be sorted by `started_at`.

children.name: q
children.description: Search the action, resource type, resource ID, and actor ID for this text.

children.name: id
children.description: Filter by audit log IDs.

children.name: actor_type
children.description: Filter by actor types.

children.name: actor_id
children.description: Filter by actor IDs.

children.name: action
children.description: Filter by actions.

children.name: resource_type
children.description: Filter by resource types.

children.name: resource_id
children.description: Filter by resource IDs.

children.name: outcome
children.description: Filter by outcomes.

children.name: started_at
children.description: Filter by when the action started.

children.name: $gt
children.description: Later than this date.

children.name: $gte
children.description: Later than or equal to this date.

children.name: $lt
children.description: Earlier than this date.

children.name: $lte
children.description: Earlier than or equal to this date.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: tags

Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: The paginated list of audit logs.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items retrieved.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: count
children.description: The total number of items.

children.name: estimate_count
children.description: The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.

deprecated.description: Use `count` instead. This property will be removed in the next minor release.

blocks.html:
This method retrieves an audit log by its ID. It sends a request to the
Get Audit Log API route. The route is only available when the Audit Module
is installed.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the audit log.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store/select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: audit_log
children.description: The audit log's details.

children.name: id
children.description: The audit log's ID.

children.name: started_at
children.description: When the action started, such as when the request arrived.

children.name: ended_at
children.description: When the action ended, such as when the response was sent.

children.name: actor_type
children.description: The type of actor that performed the action.

children.name: actor_id
children.description: The ID of the user, API key, or customer that performed the action.

children.name: impersonator_id
children.description: The ID of the Medusa staff member acting as the actor, on Medusa Cloud.

children.name: action
children.description: The name of the action, such as `order.cancel` or `POST /admin/orders/:id/cancel`.

children.name: resource_type
children.description: The type of resource acted on, such as `order`.

children.name: resource_id
children.description: The ID of the resource acted on. `null` when the action acts on several resources.

children.name: outcome
children.description:
How the action ended: `denied` for a 401 or 403 response, `failed` for any
other 4xx or 5xx response.

children.name: request
children.description: The HTTP details. `null` for an audit log written outside an API request.

children.name: request_data
children.description: The request fields that the route chose to keep.

children.name: response_data
children.description: The response fields that the route chose to keep.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Any other data attached to the audit log.
